items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Yeah, I know that's Steve down in the St. Bernard Project. He's an old timer.

ctx.x: That's who you're talking about. No, it was a clarinetist with the name of Lewis, now I can't think. No?
Now you're hitting your machine now, Steve. Oh, I know what you're talking about. You live in the St. Bernard Project. And she got, yeah, that's the Steve you talking about playing here now?
No, that's Steve Andrews down that way.
